title: Azusawa Kohane — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line: Thank you all for selecting me to be the chair of this committee. I promise to do my very best.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line: Now, I see that we have a mix of both new and returning members here today, but I'd like to take this opportunity to explain the cleanup committee's roles and duties. Firstly...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's such a good speaker, and seems like a really cool senior...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I think Honami said they were on this committee together last year.)

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line:
That concludes my overview.
Does anyone have any questions they'd like to ask?

rows.Speaker: First-Year
rows.Line: Oh, um... You said we're responsible for the flower beds in the courtyard and stuff. But that place is huge...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Yeah, that sounds really hard considering how many flower beds there are...)

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line:
Not to worry.
The school custodian takes care of most of them. We are only in charge of a few.

rows.Speaker: First-Year
rows.Line:
Oh, okay! I'm sorry...
I was worried that I wouldn't be able to spend as much time doing club activities...

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I understand why you'd be worried since I'm also in a club.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, why don't we start discussing what kinds of flowers we're going to plant this year...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, Honami was talking about this too...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. Which kinds of flowers should I suggest?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kohane, what did you think of the cleanup committee?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I was a little nervous at first since I haven't participated in many committee discussions before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Did the animal caretaker committee not have many group discussions?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We gathered in a classroom once to discuss who would be taking care of the animals on what days...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aside from that, we usually gathered by the cages or the shed where all the food and supplies were.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
It makes sense for taking care of the rabbits to take top priority.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. The teachers and more senior members taught me about how to take care of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we never really talked about why our committee exists or anything like that. I had no idea that the cleanup committee would go into so much depth.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ahaha...
The chair does like to take things seriously...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I feel a little bad about making you hear that explanation twice. I basically told you all of it already...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay! It served as a reminder, and now I have all my ducks in a row.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Besides, I'm really glad we got to talk beforehand because I was so nervous during that meeting. I might've missed some things if you hadn't explained things to me earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, thank you for your help.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I feel a little relieved is all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You decided to join the cleanup committee after I told you about my own experiences...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wasn't sure if you'd enjoy it, or if it would become too much of a burden.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I didn't know she'd been giving my decision so much thought.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's such a nice person.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Don't worry! Yes, I was nervous today, but I'm really looking forward to when we're supposed to meet next.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, we'll get to plant the flowers that everyone suggested today, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which means we can plant the ones you and I suggested, together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do our best together, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's both do our best as members of the cleanup committee.
